Method of Attack: Injects anti-war messages to Russia-based users after 15 seconds of launch, urging them to seek reliable news sources and to end the invasion of Ukraine
Impacted Systems: Applications built with event-source-polyfill npm library
Attack Vector: Fetching and running the latest version of the npm package in applications
Indicators of Compromise: Anti-war popup messages shown to Russian users
Redirects to Change.org petition signed by over 1.2 million people
Message urging to download Tor browser to bypass censorship
